name: Bell Semiconductor
old_description: Bell Semiconductor is the successor in interest to the intellectual property portfolio that originated at Bell Labs following the invention of the transistor.  Semiconductor-related R&D continued as Bell Labs became part of Lucent Technologies, and then subsequently continues as a core competency of successor companies: Agere Systems, LSI, Avago and Broadcom.
about:
Bell Semiconductor, based in Chicago, Illinois, is the successor in interest to the intellectual property portfolio that originated at Bell Labs following the invention of the transistor. The company continues the semiconductor-related R&D lineage that passed through Lucent Technologies, Agere Systems, LSI, Avago, and Broadcom. Key leaders include Chad Hilyard and Sailesh Merchant, who previously held leadership roles in intellectual property businesses at Lucent, Agere Systems, and LSI.

The company manages and licenses a portfolio of semiconductor patents and intellectual property that enables continued integration of semiconductor technology. The inventions captured in this portfolio power every hi-tech market, including smartphones, PCs, tablets, wearables, and IoT devices. Its IP is used by foundries and integrated device manufacturers across the industry.

The portfolio is presently licensed, was previously licensed, or is currently being used by virtually all foundries and integrated device manufacturers in the semiconductor manufacturing industry, serving the broader hi-tech market.

The company's portfolio traces directly to Bell Labs, where the transistor was invented, giving it a foundational role in semiconductor technology evolution.

Belmont Market has operated in Wakefield, Rhode Island, since 1947. The family-owned grocery business began as a local market and has expanded to include multiple departments and services.

The market operates a full-service grocery store with departments spanning deli, floral, grocery, health and wellness, meat, prepared foods, produce, seafood, and sushi. Its kitchen prepares meals fresh daily, and the company assembles gift baskets and offers catering for events. Online ordering supports home delivery across Washington County and Jamestown, with curbside pickup available.

The company emphasizes local sourcing where possible and promotes a "fresh from our family to yours" ethos, positioning itself as a community-focused alternative to larger chains.

name: Benco Equipment
old_description: for automotive equipment, service and financing for your business.
about:
Benco Equipment, headquartered in Bismarck, North Dakota, has been serving automotive professionals and hobbyists since 1972. The company operates as a family-owned, six-location network across the Midwest and functions as a division of Automotive Parts Headquarters Inc. (APH), a third-generation family-owned aftermarket parts distributor founded in 1920 in Minneapolis as National Bushing & Parts Company.

Benco specializes in the sales, service, installation, inspection, and financing of automotive service equipment. Its six stores stock a large inventory of lifts, air compressors, tire equipment, A/C machines, diagnostic tools, piping systems, and waste oil heaters. Factory-trained technicians provide in-house and mobile repair services, manage replacement parts inventories, and perform inspections following ANSI/ALI ALOIM standards. The network also offers operator training and financing options.

The company serves automotive repair shops requiring light, medium, and heavy-duty lifts, as well as heavy-duty and industrial facilities, motorcycle and ATV shops, and hobbyists throughout the Midwest. Its customer base includes independent garages, dealerships, fleet maintenance operations, and industrial plants across North Dakota, Minnesota, Wisconsin, and South Dakota.

Benco emphasizes comprehensive regional coverage, claiming to sell and service more equipment than any other provider in the area. Its differentiators include a large local inventory at each location, factory-trained technicians capable of servicing all makes and models, and a full suite of support services from installation through inspection and repair.

name: Benfield Control Systems Inc.
old_description: LV and MV power distribution equipment, including switchgear up to 38kV class
about:
Benfield Control Systems Inc., operating as Benfield Electric Supply Co. Inc., is headquartered in Mount Vernon, New York, with a second location in White Plains. The company was founded in 1951 and remains independently owned, having grown from a local electrical supply house into a multi-division distributor serving the New York metropolitan area and beyond.

The business operates across six divisions: Benfield Electric Supply, Benfield Data Comm, Benfield Electric & Elevator Supply, Benfield Control Systems, Lighting, and International. Its 24 service trucks support same-day pickup and next-day delivery across New York City and the Lower Hudson Valley. The company maintains a broad inventory of electrical distribution equipment, elevator wire and rope, building wire, fire alarm cable, conduit, cable tray, lighting, motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, medium-voltage switchgear up to 38 kV, UPS systems, VFDs, and UL 508A-listed industrial control panels. In-house capabilities include value engineering, project management, RCDD-certified data engineers, FOA-certified fiber optic technicians, pre-fabrication, SCADA/CPMS software development, and custom power distribution system design.

Benfield serves industrial enterprises, corporations, original equipment manufacturers, and construction firms. Notable customers include Weill Cornell Medical Center and Lutheran Medical Center, reflecting a strong presence in healthcare. Other markets include commercial construction, data communications, elevator systems, HVAC, power distribution, and renewable energy such as solar, wind, and EV charging infrastructure.

The company emphasizes its independence as a differentiator, stating it is not bound by corporate red tape and can adapt quickly to customer needs. It highlights over 400 years of combined staff experience, recognition on the Westchester 50 list of privately owned businesses, and active community involvement through local hiring and charitable support.

All manufacturing is kept in-house, covering plastic injection molding, 3D printing and prototyping, product development, injection mold making, and finishing services. A dedicated team of engineers and technicians manages projects from initial design through full-scale production runs.

The company serves a range of industries including baby products, food service, consumer goods, health and beauty, electrical, industrial, pharmaceutical, and retail markets. Customers rely on Bennett for both prototype development and high-volume production of components used in consumer and industrial applications.

Bennett Plastics emphasizes direct communication, a no-outsourcing policy, and a Fast-Track Mold Insert Program that can deliver molded samples in as little as five weeks. name: Benteler Automotive Corporation
old_description: Since the company was founded by Carl Benteler in 1876, foresight has been the foundation of our success. From trading to manufacturing, from a regional supplier to an international technology leader – BENTELER has always moved ahead while others hesitated.
about:
Benteler Automotive Corporation traces its roots to 1876 when Carl Benteler opened a small hardware store in Bielefeld, Germany. The company evolved from trading into a global metal-processing and automotive technology group. Its U.S. headquarters are in Goshen, Indiana, while the global holding is based in Salzburg, Austria.

Today Benteler operates as a metal-processing specialist with more than 20,000 employees across roughly 90 sites in 25 countries. Its manufacturing footprint includes stamping, assembly, module and chassis production, as well as seamless and welded tube mills and steelmaking facilities. The company also runs tool shops, machinery manufacturing units, engineering hubs, and shared-service centers in Europe and the Americas.

The business serves primarily the automotive industry as a Tier 1 supplier of chassis components, module assemblies, and structural parts. It also supplies precision steel tubes to energy providers and industrial customers for applications requiring high load capacity and durability. Concrete examples from its portfolio include crash management systems, axle modules, and free-cutting steel tubing for hydraulic and mechanical uses.

Benteler emphasizes its 150-year heritage of "pioneering spirit in motion" and a focus on making mobility safer and more sustainable. The company says its differentiation lies in combining deep material expertise with full-process control—from steelmaking to finished modules—to deliver integrated, lightweight solutions for OEMs worldwide.

name: Benton & Sons
old_description: Custom fabricated steel parts and components, structural steel fabrications, steel machine bases and more. Specializes in large component steel fabrication.
about:
Benton & Sons Fabrication operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Pikeville, North Carolina, about 60 miles southeast of Raleigh. The company was founded in 1983 by Ben Benton Jr. and remains family-owned and operated, with three generations of the Benton family having worked in the business.

The shop specializes in heavy steel plate fabrication, stainless steel sheet metal fabrication, and the customized assembly of machinery and equipment. Core processes include plate rolling, brake press forming, punching, shearing, laser cutting, and water jet cutting. Notable equipment includes a 1,000-ton by 24-foot CNC-controlled Cincinnati brake press, a TRUMPF 6,000-watt TruLaser 5060, and a Mitsubishi 6030XL laser cutter—one of only two in the Western Hemisphere. The facility features multiple bays, large overhead doors, and overhead cranes to handle large-scale fabrications and assemblies such as structural steel components, machine bases, commercial kitchen equipment, pharmaceutical and laboratory apparatus, and decorative metal yard art.

Benton & Sons serves customers across the Southeast and Mid-Atlantic, including Maryland, Virginia, the Carolinas, and Georgia. Its client base spans food processing, commercial kitchens, pharmaceutical plants, shipbuilding, nuclear facilities, transportation, beverage bottling, and fine chemicals. The company’s proximity to I-95, I-40, rail lines, and East Coast ports supports domestic and international shipping.

The business emphasizes quick turnaround times and on-budget delivery. During the 2008–2009 recession, ownership kept the crew employed by building an 18-foot T-rex sculpture, a project that also sharpened fabrication skills and spawned a line of metal garden sculptures.
